subject: Fixed-rate renewal shield: OncoSoft 3yr commit — exec approval needed

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fixed-rate renewal shield: OncoSoft 3yr commit — need leadership sign-off

Folks,

Quick summary: OncoSoft (AI diagnostics) is proposing a 3-year committed deal with a request that we fix per-token rates for the first two renewals and add a cap on annual uplift (3% max). They want a renewal-protection clause that prevents unilateral price increases above the cap if they maintain >=80% of committed usage.

Current commercial ask (from Samir):
- 3-year term, $1.5M ARR equivalent commit year 1 (tiered consumption).
- Fixed per-token floor for first 24 months, then review at year 3.
- Annual uplift cap: 3% (vs our standard 5–8% for multi-year).
- Standard data/security requirements satisfied; procurement sent updated SOW and redlines (attached).

Why this matters: OncoSoft is a high-visibility pilot with potential upsell across their imaging & research teams. Loss risk is moderate — they can move to self-host but need our managed features (routing, private). Approving a narrower uplift cap increases competitive win probability but reduces flexibility on price corrections for market shifts.

Ask: need exec/finance approval to accept the 3% uplift cap and the fixed-rate clause for the first two renewals. Also recommend adding a codified rollback trigger (we can add a clause to revisit uplift if aggregate cloud egress or GPU-cost index rises >12% over 12 months).

Attachments: OncoSoft_MAAP_v3_redlines.pdf, 3yr-pricing-model.xlsx

--
Neha Kapoor

Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fixed-rate renewal shield: OncoSoft 3yr commit — need leadership sign-off

Neha — good concise write-up, thanks. A few clarifications from GTM/Deal Desk perspective:

- Net effect on 3yr list pricing: modeled WA rate is ~18% below list assuming commit & minimal overage.
- We currently have an internal guardrail that caps uplift concessions to 4% without finance sign-off; 3% is outside that.
- OncoSoft is asking for the renewal-protection to be contractual, not just a sales promise — they attached the procurement redlines.

I ran a sensitivity on adoption risk vs price: if they drop to 60% of commit in year 2, our unit revenue falls below acceptable thresholds. The proposed rollback trigger (cost-index + usage threshold) makes sense to protect us.

Suggested compromise language (for legal):
- Renewal Protection: For the first two renewals, per-token price shall not increase by more than 3% annually provided Customer meets >=80% of the prior 12-month committed usage.
- Cost-Index Exception: Redwood reserves the right to reopen pricing if there is an industry-wide cost increase exceeding 12% measured by the Redwood GPU/Cloud Cost Index over a trailing 12-month period.

If finance/legal are comfortable with the Cost-Index Exception being objective and auditable, I recommend escalation.

Marissa
Director, Deal Strategy | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fixed-rate renewal shield: OncoSoft 3yr commit — need leadership sign-off

Team — quick finance view:

- I ran the attached 3yr-pricing-model.xlsx against our unit-cost assumptions. If OncoSoft meets >=80% of commit, IRR is acceptable but tight vs. other anchor deals.
- The Cost-Index Exception is acceptable if we define the index and a public data source for auditability (e.g., average GPU spot price + cloud egress basket). Avoid vendor-specific measures.
- Require a minimum annual cadence for invoice/usage reconciliation and a 60-day cure period before any price change is invoked.

Risks:
- If usage drops unexpectedly (60% of commit), our margin would be negative on incremental tokens. We should add a minimal fallback: a floor per-token (no lower than X cents) and right to convert residual commitment to a discounted one-time credit if they underdeliver at year-end.

Conclusion: Finance can support 3% uplift cap with the index exception + reconciliation/cure language + fallback floor. Approve subject to legal draft.

-Markus
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Looping Lauren for final exec sign-off.

Suggested executive memo (for clarity) to include in the approval thread to make it easy for Lauren/CEO to sign:
- Customer: OncoSoft (Series B, healthcare imaging).
- Ask: Accept 3% annual uplift cap for first two renewals + fixed-rate protection given >=80% committed usage.
- Commercial tradeoffs: Improves close odds materially; reduces pricing agility. Mitigations: Cost-Index Exception, 60-day cure, annual reconciliation, minimum per-token floor and conversion credit at under-delivery.
- Financial impact: Modeled at conservative+ base -> ~8% below our preferred target margin if customer hits >=80% usage.
- Recommendation: Approve conditionally; delegate to Revenue Ops to sign the exact legal language after legal/finance finalize.

If Lauren can greenlight this conditional approval, we will send the proposed clause to OncoSoft and ask for a streamlined DocuSign.
